newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen remaining steady.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen remaining steady.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to remain at current levels in the immediate term, pastorol group Wesfrmers Dalgety said.
Sales this week are in Goulburn, Adelaide and Fremantle with 102,756 bales on offer
The eastern market indicator rose three cents to 553 cents a kilo clean last week, while the western market indicator fell three cents to 517 cents a kilo clean since sales two weeks ago.
Some exporters report that recent low prices have triggered orders from price sensitive Chinese buyers, many of whom are prepared to abstain from buying until prices match expectations.
"This is always to be expected when there is not strong widespread competition in the market," the council said.
Wesfarmers said the market is at a low point and suggests a degree of market certainty which will hopefully stimulate business and assist new orders in the near future.
"The current seasonally large offerings, for the next month, will stifle any upward movement and maintain prices at current levels in the immediate term," Wesfarmers said.
